query:
UPDATE accounts
           SET display_name = $2,
               note = $3,
               inbox_url = $4,
               shared_inbox_url = $5,
               public_key = $6,
               avatar_remote_url = COALESCE($7, avatar_remote_url),
               header_remote_url = CASE WHEN $8 != '' THEN $8 ELSE header_remote_url END,
               also_known_as = $9,
               updated_at = now()
           WHERE uri = $1 AND uri != ''
           RETURNING id
